# Erdos.p865 — Erdős problem 865

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/865
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/865.lean`, theorem `erdos_865.variants.sos`, AMS 5 11).

Erdős and Sós conjectured that
$f_k(N)\sim \frac{1}{2}\left(1+\sum_{1\leq r\leq k-2}\frac{1}{4^r}\right) N$,
where $f_k(N)$ is the minimal size of a subset of $\{1, \dots, N\}$ guaranteeing $k$ elements
have all pairwise sums in the set.

## Statement
∀ᵉ (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k),
    (fun N ↦ (f N k : ℝ)) ~[atTop] (fun N ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 + ∑ r ∈ Icc 1 (k - 2),
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ r) * N)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
